messages:
alex: Morning — quick async check-in for docs/sampleapps.
alex: Yesterday: finished Rust sampleapp quickstart, added note about macOS M1 wheels and a small snippet for the JS -> Rust bridge. Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/321
morgan: Nice. Saw the PR — CI failing on macos-latest for x86 build step (pip build wheel). Error looks like a path issue in setup.cfg.
morgan: I can take a look this afternoon.
sam: Blocker: the embeddings example in the quickstart still uses the old `embed()` API. Need to update to `client.embeddings.create({ model, input })` otherwise tests fail.
liz: I left a comment on the PR about that. Also suggested adding a note about rate limits for free-tier users (:warning:).
alex: Good catch, sam. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR to update the example. ping @morgan for the mac build fix.
ci-bot: build/devex-rust-matrix (macos-latest) — FAILED — details: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/ci/6543
morgan: repro'd locally, pushing a fix branch now. If anyone's blocked on the sampleapp demo for the meetup, I can prioritize.
alex: Blockers: need reviews on PR 321 and approval for the embeddings snippet change. Otherwise nothing blocking deploy.
alex: Today: address Liz's doc comments, land the embedding API snippet PR, and draft release notes for sampleapp v0.3.0.
sam: I'll review PR 321 after lunch and validate the embedding snippet in the integration test.
liz: Quick heads-up: can we add a one-line troubleshooting FAQ for M1 installs in the quickstart? Users hit that twice on support.
morgan: Yep will add the FAQ entry in the build-fix PR.
alex: Thanks team. If anyone wants the demo branch, it's `demo/rust-quickstart-v3`.
alex: final: please react with :thumbsup: when you've reviewed/owned items.
